claimCorrections.repair: Native systems may avoid STT on the primary acoustic path while retaining transcript/semantic side channels for tools, audit, accessibility and recovery.

claimCorrections.claim: MLA should be specified for all voice inference
claimCorrections.repair: Use MLA only when the selected model implements compatible MLA; otherwise estimate its actual attention/cache architecture.

claimCorrections.claim: MTP guarantees sub-100ms TTFT or 2.5x clause speed
claimCorrections.repair: Benchmark model/server/hardware; MTP/speculation affects decoding throughput/latency according to implementation and acceptance.
Measure codec/model algorithmic delay; discrete codecs are not categorically disqualified.

claimCorrections.claim: Straight OT path implies accurate one-step Euler synthesis
claimCorrections.repair: Benchmark quality/error versus NFE; training path geometry does not guarantee learned field integration accuracy at NFE=1.

claimCorrections.claim: Provided barge-in function computes Lie bracket
claimCorrections.repair: It computes an orthogonal residual, not [U,V]=DV·U-DU·V; projection must use the correct vector in numerator/denominator.
Treat clocks/manifold geometry as experimentally selected model profiles.
Require explicit algorithm, approximation error, retention policy and measured complexity.

decision: Create a Frontier Voice Architecture Selector skill and a separate CGSS Formula Lab candidate; do not overwrite the already-qualified cascaded skill.
